tools.description: Recalculate the signed-in user's own workout (elevation, weather, derived stats and records) from its source. Only the owner can refresh it. The recalculation updates derived analytics rather than the workout's own row.
tools._residual: Refresh recalculates derived analytics (elevation, weather, records) from the workout's source. Those are computed values, not a single row-write the runtime can assert, so a refresh call is owner-gated but produces no verifiable world change on its own; it is the entry point a client would call after uploading/changing source data.

summary: FitTrackee is a self-hosted workout tracker (Flask + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL + authlib OAuth2). Users create/import workouts with GPS files, attach equipment and media, post comments, follow each other, and moderators handle reports/suspensions.
